flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Store the name of the first product in the product list as product_name, and store the exact stock or scarcity message shown on that product's card (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock") as stock_1.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ again so the page fully loads fresh.
Find the product card whose name is exactly {{product_name}}, store that card's product name as product_name_2 and its stock message as stock_2.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ once more, find the card named {{product_name}} again, and store its product name as product_name_3 and its stock message as stock_3.
Always read the same product, never a different one.
Read each value from the page after its own fresh load; do not copy an earlier value.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there is no stock message, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
